translations./garage/brief: Collect the spare battery, stop on the 20° slope to check traction margin, then deliver the equipment to the communications bridge. Motor, tires, and driving preference determine whether RO-1 can restart.
translations./prediction/hint: Judge the available torque first, then consider energy use.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Use the debrief to inspect grade and traction saturation, then identify where the margin came from.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: A higher top speed guarantees a stronger start
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: A slope start happens near zero speed. Wheel force matters here; no-load rpm does not.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Load secured. I’ll stop on the slope, then restart.
translations./debrief/success_summary: The debrief recorded grade, body attitude, slip, and energy use throughout the delivery.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Inspect grade, wheel-force saturation, and rollover risk on the timeline, then adjust the build or driving preference.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Longitudinal slope, cross-slope, body attitude, and energy use come from the same fixed-step simulation.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/collision-static: Ramp mission failed: left the feasible region
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Ramp mission failed: time limit exceeded
